name: معلّقات المجاري (قضبان وزوايا رف)

sample.sheet: MECH1 ص9–10 (جدول معلّقات المجاري: القطر والزاوية والتباعد الأقصى)

assumed: the table is read as a function of the LARGER duct side (assumed reading of 'duct dim.')
hangers are spread evenly on each straight segment so spacing never exceeds the table maximum
rods rise to the slab soffit of the level (at least 4 cm); ducts resting on the roof (< 0.9 m above the floor) and vertical segments get no hanger
the shelf angle is drawn as a short tube of the angle leg size; rods and the shelf are separate pieces (U-shaped rod path + angle)
proposed (assumed-route) ducts and restored-candidate strokes get no hangers
